content5.ptxt: Each time the IG is turned ON, the skid control computer acquires the steering sensor 0 point by driving straight ahead at a vehicle speed of 35km/h or more for approximately 5 seconds, and also stores past 0 point positions.

If an alignment adjustment, steering wheel position adjustment, etc. is performed without disconnecting the battery terminal, or if yaw rate sensor 0 point acquisition is not performed after adjustment, a difference between the steering sensor 0 point acquired value while driving and the stored value is detected, and a steering angle sensor 0 point malfunction code is output as an adjustment malfunction.
The warning for the steering angle sensor 0 point malfunction code is canceled by turning the IG OFF.

entry.ptxt: Steering sensor 0 point acquisition position differs from stored value (angle has become large)

item.ptxt: Yaw Rate Sensor 0 Point Not Calibrated

test1.ptxt: Perform yaw rate & G sensor 0 point clearing and acquisition. (see )

item.ptxt: The steering sensor 0 point memory is also cleared by the yaw rate & G sensor memory clearing work.

If the yaw rate & G sensor 0 point and output values or the speed sensor output values are abnormal, steering sensor 0 point acquisition is not performed normally even when driving straight ahead at 35km/h or more.

test1.ptxt: Drive straight ahead at 35km/h or more for 5 seconds or more.
With the vehicle driving straight ahead, check that the steering straight-ahead position is correct.

atten4.ptxt: If front wheel alignment adjustment or steering position adjustment has been performed due to a steering straight-ahead position malfunction, perform yaw rate & G sensor 0 point acquisition again after completing the work.
